issue.title: getValues doesn't use nest flag for defaultValues

repository.name: react-hook-form
repository.description: 📋 React Hooks for form state management and validation (Web + React Native)

issue.body: **Describe the bug** For https://github.com/react-hook-form/react-hook-form/issues/222 (PR https://github.com/react-hook-form/react-hook-form/pull/223), we added the ability to return `defaultValue` from `getValue` before the form is modified. When trying to use the `nest: true` option, it correctly nests _after_ the form was modified, but not before (when falling back to `defaultValue`). **To Reproduce** 1. Set up a form with nested default values 2. `console.log(getValue({ nest: true })` 3. Notice that before modifying the form, the console outputs _unnested_ data 4. Type in a field 5. Now, the console will output _nested_ data **Codesandbox link** https://codesandbox.io/s/react-hook-form-defaultvalues-gl8b1 **Screenshots** **Additional context** Using react-hook-form 3.23.12

issue.title: getValues and submitting returns empty object on first click, returns correct values on second click

repository.name: react-hook-form
repository.description: 📋 React Hooks for form state management and validation (Web + React Native)

issue.body: This could be a regression that was fixed here https://github.com/react-hook-form/react-hook-form/issues/222. I notice the same behaviour: submitting a form or calling getValues returns an empty object the first time, returns the correct values if pressed again. I have a form which is build dynamically from data fetched externally. I build my input components mapping them from a fieldType key in the response object. I'm trying to build a multistep form, so field names SHOULD be different, but COULD be have the same name. The way I have built my form is following the Smart Component suggestion and I register inputs with formContext. I have tried using fieldArrays and I get the same result, so that is not a solution. **Expected behavior** Submitting or calling getValues() returns form values. **Screenshots** **Desktop (please complete the following information):** - OS: MacOS catalina - Browser chrome and firefox - Version 4.6.2
